newsitem.title: ITALY: Specialists bid for 2.0 bln lire of Italy CCTs.
newsitem.headline: Specialists bid for 2.0 bln lire of Italy CCTs.

text.p: Specialist bond traders bid for and were allotted two billion lire worth of seven-year variable-rate certificates (CCT) against the Italian Treasury's offer of 300 billion lire of paper.

Earlier, the Treasury received bids for 4.789 trillion lire at the open auction of a new first tranche of the January 1, 2004 paper paying a first coupon of 3.45 percent, against 3.0 trillion lire worth on offer.
The CCTs were assigned at a price of 100.65 with a gross yield of 6.79 percent and net yield of 5.92 percent.
